notes.title: Development of Mommy's Boy continues!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

Our audio guy worked his ass off we've finally got every voice line cut and programmed into the game! With that, Mommy's Boy is now on v0.3.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44933924/d43dd51a4b0050ecebe94ebbdcac9d92fee7bcf3.png[/img]

Once again, I would like to remind everyone that this is a slow-burn story, and full sex events will take a while to appear.

There are a lot of variables in Mommy's Boy which will take time to fully develop. Some choices you make will be felt in the next scene, others may not become clear until the next day, and other situations may arise from continuing to act in a certain way for several days.

Some of the best corruption and NTR games we have played feature a character stats pages which tracks their descent into corruption. It records things like total number of times they have climaxed, fetishes they have gained, and helps track how the character falls over time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44933924/3b37c3e0447858388260e009f1a1710c381ac756.png[/img]

It felt amiss to not include something similar in Mommy's Boy as well.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44933924/0af053a3e6140cf730ff09dbd6100b76c3a22a43.png[/img]

Therefore, in addition to Day 2, we are also implementing corruption and stat updates! Every touch, every kiss, every climax, every instance of masturbation is all tracked on Lauren's page.

Additionally, we will also be monitoring what Jacob has experienced, etching the NTR in place as records of what your son has done with Vicki get recorded.

The corruption and NTR tracking is still in its very early stages, and we'll be expanding it out with update. It can be accessed by clicking the "Stats" button in the top left corner. (The hearts with the red lines beside them!)

In terms of general improvements, we have fixed more typos, re-recorded a bunch of voice lines which we weren't happy with, and added in some small quality of life and accessibility features such as an option to increase the font size.

We're already working on Day 3's development, when things will begin to heat up in terms of erotic content.

Keep an eye out and don't forget to add us to your wishlist - Mommy's Boy will be coming to Steam in the near future!

Thanks again for your support,

Onyxdime and the MB Team
